messages:
zyra: Quick sync: proposing a slightly different post-launch flow to reduce churn — micro-batches every 3 weeks for low-priority items, sprint fixes for P2, and immediate hotfix lane for P0/P1. Short doc and owners below.

felix: curious why 3 weeks? that's unusual vs 4-6 but could help iterate faster on UX tweaks.

zyra: Exactly — 3-week cadence keeps momentum without too many rollouts. Hotfix lane still immediate. Main change: explicit defect budget per squad and an "escape hatch" for customers with commercial urgency.

eden: From eng: fine with 3-week micro-batches if feature-flags are mandatory. Also require a 1-line dev estimate before scheduling P1 hotfixes.

sam: telemetry: I'll add two compact rules: sustained error >0.6% for 10m = P1 alert; customer-reported repro + data loss -> P0. Will push a compact panel to #product-telemetry.

mina: CS request: we need clear reply templates for customers. If it's in the micro-batch, CS should say "grouped release in next 3-week batch" with an ETA date. For hotfixes say 24-72h depending on severity.

zyra: Draft rubric (compact):
```
P0: security/data loss -> immediate page, target patch 24h, owner: oncall
P1: core flow broken, no workaround -> triage 4h, patch within 72h or hotfix window, owner: squad oncall
P2: degraded core flow with workaround or >1% traffic -> schedule in next sprint or emergency hotfix if customer-exception, owner: squad lead
P3: UX/perf/nice-to-have -> micro-batch every 3 weeks, owner: product grooming
DoR: repro, customer-tier, telemetry link, 1-line dev-est
DoD: tests, ff toggle, rollback note
```

felix: capacity guardrails: suggest reserve 20% of squad capacity for reactive work for first 6 weeks post-launch. If reactive >20% for 2 cycles -> trigger roadmap pause.

eden: Also add rule: any P1 estimated >4 dev-days gets reclass to P2 unless CS tags as contractual SLA. Avoid hotfixs that are really big.

sam: I'll implement a compact dashboard alert that DM's owners if the defect budget crosses thresholds and post weekly summary.

mina: I'll add customer templates and the "commercial-exception" intake flow: CS must add RevOps approval + revenue rationale. Exceptions capped at 2 concurrent per squad.

deploy-bot: Runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/micro-batch-postlaunch> (auto-posted)

zyra: Actions: 1) mina -> customer templates + exception intake form by EOD. 2) felix -> update roadmap cards with 20% reactive cap + trigger rule. 3) eden -> quick-est requirement + reclass rule. 4) sam -> dashboards + defect-budget alert. I'll schedule 15m sync Wed 10:00 to finalize wording.

mina: Confirmed. I'll also include a canned rollback blurb CS can send to customers.

felix: Confirmed. I'll add a small column on the roadmap board for "reactive budget" and automation.

eden: Confirmed. I'll paste quick-est template into issue template.

sam: Confirmed. Will post dashboard link here when ready.

zyra: Anything blocking?

den: none here.

mina: No blockers.

zyra: Great — will post the one-pager after Wed sync. Drop edge cases here before then.
